Title: Azure Site Recovery now supports replication with private links

Body.Content:
Azure Site Recovery now supports Private Links, which can be used to replicate Azure machines, VMware machines, physical machines, and Hyper-V machines. Using Private Link ensures secured connectivity to Site Recovery service URLs. One private endpoint will be required in your private network for access to recovery services vault and a second endpoint for data replication to cache storage account. 

This feature is generally available in South Central US, West US 2, East US, and Azure Government regions. It will be available in all public regions by August 2020 with the exception of South Africa North, South Africa West and France South which have forecasted availability for October 2020.

Learn more about using private links in Azure Site Recovery for protection of Azure machines and on-premises machines.
